pages.prompt: Create ONE polished full-color fantasy manga page, landscape 3:2, 4 readable bordered panels with clean pale gutters, expressive ink linework, painterly color, sophisticated lighting, natural anatomy. HERO FRONTIER story V2 visual proof: ancient neutral trading town, NOT kingdom capital. Reading order left-to-right then down. Top half wide establishing panel: small riverside market around a crescent river bend, distinctive split grey rock on far shore, humble wooden landing below a low stone retaining wall, a squat square warehouse with a red-brown tiled roof, only a dozen low buildings and open grass beyond. Different ordinary travelers arriving along separate roads, no unified party. Bottom three panels: left close-up a stocky freckled HUMAN WOMAN cartwright, dark auburn cropped hair and leather work apron, examining a cart's broken axle; middle slim SILVERLEAF MALE trader with long pointed ears, black hair in tight low knot, narrow long face, indigo travel tunic, offers suitable timber while remaining beside his own pack mule; right ordinary DUSKFOLK WOMAN technician, blunt black bob hair, amber eyes, rounded face, dark wine work jacket and brass measuring tool, checks axle diameter with calipers as cartwright agrees. Distinct faces NOT handsome hero designs, no silver hair, purple eyes, white fur collars, crowns or leaf tiaras. Developed crafts and careful tools, not cavemen. Background ordinary local workers. They are negotiating one paid job not founding civilization or an adventurer team. No kingdom palace, cathedral, castle skyline, heraldry, national flags, blue/gold banners, giant magical effects. Warm morning colors but not sepia. Only 3 exact traditional Chinese readable text balloons and one small caption: top caption「古時・商路的交會處」; bottom left「車軸斷了，今天走不了。」; bottom middle「我有合適的木料。」; bottom right「先量尺寸，再談工錢。」. No other text. Critical landmarks remain visible for a future same-site modern comparison. This page is a SAMPLE within a longer story, not the entire origin condensed to one page.

pages.purpose: 同址當代城市對照，非正式主線頁
pages.prompt: Create a NEW full color fantasy manga page in exactly the same polished ink-and-painted-color style and 3:2 landscape page proportions as image 1. Image 1 is ONLY reference for SAME GEOGRAPHIC SITE and art style, NOT characters to copy. This page takes place MANY GENERATIONS LATER in the modern era of this medieval-fantasy world (no automobiles, electrical poles, sci-fi). Exactly 4 panels reading left-to-right then down, wide top establishing panel and 3 bottom panels. Top panel SAME CAMERA and spatial anchors as reference: forked rocky hill on opposite left bank, crescent river curves in same direction, old squat red tiled warehouse same place near right bank now surrounded by a much larger working COMMON CITY. Old stone steps and humble landing retained in a small inset basin, broader tiered stone wharves beyond, sailing cargo boats, 3-4 story timber/stone warehouses and workshops, public logistics hall, bridges and street network extending back right. Older small warehouse remains visible, NOT replaced with palace. Busy but coherent real city; no royal castles, cathedral spires, flag seas, royal guards or national symbols. Instead small hanging pictorial trade signs and common public buildings. Clear infrastructure expansion, residents organized and clothing more elaborate, not a filter change. Bottom left: new elderly HUMAN MALE dockworker with bald head, grey moustache, broad nose, ochre guild vest, explaining an unloading route to new cropped copper-haired round-eared human woman dispatcher in neat teal coat with ledger; no blue gold hero armor. Bottom middle: a new dark-brown-skinned long-pointed-eared SILVERLEAF FEMALE merchant with short black pixie cut, amber eyes, burnt-orange formal coat, showing a broken cart wheel to dispatcher while grain porters pass; NOT long brown hair green eyes leaf tiara heroine. Bottom right: dispatcher writes a repair entry while harbor workers open a route; ordinary people managing public life, not three founders immortal in new clothes. All have distinct expressive detailed faces. No silver/white hair purple eyed hooded woman. Only exact traditional Chinese text: top caption「當代・共同城市」; bottom left balloon「船多了，卸貨得分流。」; bottom middle balloon「先留一條讓人走的路。」; bottom right balloon「通道先空出來，修繕也要記下。」. No other labels. This is a same-site contrast SAMPLE, not final script page.
pages.repairPrompt: Edit this color manga page with ONE precise continuity correction. Preserve all architecture, geography, page composition, panels, other characters, clothing, props, lettering, color and style exactly. Change ONLY the human female dispatcher who appears in the lower left, lower middle edge and lower right panels: she must be a completely DIFFERENT person from the red-haired freckled ancient cartwright. Give this contemporary dispatcher a long slender middle-aged face, deep brown skin, black straight hair smoothly parted on the side into a low bun, thin arched eyebrows, a long straight narrow nose, NO freckles, dark brown eyes, modest gold stud earrings. Keep her teal tailored coat and ledger, body poses and the exact speech balloons unchanged. Apply consistent new face/hair/skin to EVERY appearance in all three bottom panels. This ordinary modern human woman is not a game hero and not related to any ancient cast. No other changes.
